# Read-only commands against the server.
server info --query "{major: major, minor: minor, pgaadauth: pgaadauthVersion, database: database}"
server info --query currentUser -o tsv
db list --query "[?name=='postgres']"
schema list --database postgres
principal list --query "length(@) > `0`"
principal list --exclude-self --exclude-names '["azpgaad_test_nobody"]' --query "[?starts_with(name, 'azpgaad_test_')]"
role list --all --query "[?roleName=='azure_pg_admin'].{name: roleName, aad: aad}"
